details: Bitcoin is showing strong momentum, trading above $63,000 and pushing towards the $65,000 resistance level. After a period of mixed flows earlier in the week, Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) experienced significant inflows, totaling $265.7 million. BlackRock's IBIT alone accounted for $209.4 million of these inflows.
title: Bitcoin Nears $65K, Sees Strong ETF Inflows

details: Standard Chartered has reaffirmed its optimistic prediction for Bitcoin, forecasting that the cryptocurrency will reach $100,000 by the end of 2026. The bank attributes recent price volatility to communication issues surrounding MicroStrategy's treasury strategy rather than a fundamental decline in Bitcoin's long-term outlook.
title: Standard Chartered Maintains Bitcoin $100K Forecast by EOY 2026

details: Prediction market platform Polymarket is actively pursuing regulatory approvals to introduce margin trading services in the United States. This move could significantly expand the types of financial products available to its users.
title: Polymarket Seeks US Approval for Margin Trading

details: An international law enforcement effort, "Operation First Light 2026," coordinated by Interpol, successfully dismantled a $122 million cryptocurrency scheme. The operation led to the arrest of 5,811 suspects and the seizure of approximately $293 million in illicit assets globally.
title: Interpol Busts $122M Crypto Scheme, Arrests Thousands

details: Cryptocurrency exchange AscendEX announced that it ceased all operations as of July 1, 2026. The decision was attributed to regulatory pressures from the European Union's Markets in Crypto-Assets (MiCA) regulation, which came into effect on the same date, alongside existing financial and operational challenges. The company warned users that they may not be able to recover the full amount of their crypto assets.
title: AscendEX Exchange Halts Operations Due to MiCA Regulations

details: BNB Chain is developing a new Layer-1 blockchain specifically designed for AI trading agents. The new network aims to achieve transaction preconfirmation in under 50 milliseconds and will integrate into the broader BNB Chain ecosystem, enhancing speed and efficiency for on-chain AI-driven transactions.
title: BNB Chain Unveils New Layer-1 Blockchain for AI Trading Agents

details: The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) has included crypto asset rulemaking amendments in its 2026 Regulatory Agenda. The proposed changes are expected to address the offer and sale of crypto assets, market structure, and broker-dealer financial responsibility and record-keeping rules, potentially introducing new exemptions and safe harbors.
title: SEC's 2026 Regulatory Agenda Includes Crypto Asset Amendments

details: The launch of Robinhood's new Layer 2 chain, built using Arbitrum's technology, has positively impacted several tokens. Arbitrum (ARB) surged 13.5%, while Ethena's $50 million USDe deposit into Robinhood Chain vaults significantly boosted the platform's Total Value Locked (TVL) and rallied ENA by 4.13%.
title: Robinhood Chain Launch Boosts Arbitrum and Ethena

details: Zcash (ZEC) experienced a 12% price increase following news that developers are close to providing formal proof that the Ironwood shielded pools are free of undetectable counterfeiting bugs. This development aims to restore confidence and address prior vulnerabilities in the privacy-focused cryptocurrency.
title: Zcash Nears Proof of Ironwood Shielded Pool Security
